name: Yakuake
blurb: Yakuake is a drop-down terminal emulator based on KDE Konsole technology.
description:
Yakuake is a drop-down terminal emulator based on KDE Konsole technology.

Features:

• Smoothly rolls down from the top of your screen

• Tabbed interface

• Configurable dimensions and animation speed

• Skinnable

• Sophisticated D-Bus interface

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
